bullets: Generalize blank-window guidance beyond the system backdrop: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md + SKILL.md now cover the scaffold's extended/custom title bar (ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar + <TitleBar>) as a sibling composition-dependent cause and instruct reverting to the default title bar for standard-title-bar UWP originals — because removing <Window.SystemBackdrop> alone left LampArray still rendering blank.

Soften 'removing the backdrop restores reliable rendering' to 'necessary but not sufficient' and add that a populated UIA/visual tree does not prove a page paints, so agents keep looking when a window is still blank after the backdrop fix.

Add Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 Section 9b: WARN on ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar=true / <TitleBar> control (pointing to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#titlebar-blank) so the extended-title-bar blank-render risk is surfaced by the mandatory validator, not just prose.
deferred_to_human: Tier-0: consider having the migration scaffold emit a plain default-title-bar MainWindow (no ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar / <TitleBar> / SystemBackdrop) so migrations start from reliably-composited chrome.
